name: io.github.kenzolika/yandex-music-mcp
title: Yandex Music (unofficial)
description: Unofficial Yandex Music server: search, likes, history, My Wave, playlists. Token stays local.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MUSIC_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex Music OAuth token. Optional: by default it is read from ~/.yandex-music-mcp/token created by yandex-music-mcp-auth.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MUSIC_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file with the token, if it is not in the default location.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MUSIC_EXPORT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for .txt/.csv exports. Default: Documents/Yandex Music exports.
